items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five titled Cards with Field labels above every input, but CardContent uses 'grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2', so fields sit in two columns (First name / Last name side by side in screenshot). Not single column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Field.tsx: required gets red ' *', others get '(optional)'; header states 'Fields marked * are required'. Documents also use '(optional)'.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Types are right (type=date, email, tel, inputMode numeric), but every input fills its half-width grid cell: Postcode, Date of birth, Start date, Tax ID are as wide as Street/City in the screenshot. No narrow widths.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: 'Save draft' button calls saveDraft() which does no validation (toast only). Note: nothing is actually persisted.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: div 'fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0' bar with Cancel, Save draft, 'Create employee' (verb, no disabled prop); visible in first viewport screenshot.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: Validation runs only in onSubmit; no onBlur handlers. Summary Alert with anchor links exists, but on failure code only scrollIntoView on #form-summary; no focus() on summary or first invalid field.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: No beforeunload listener or navigation guard anywhere in onboarding-form.tsx; Cancel is a plain Link.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Only the first document hint says 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB'; other rows have no types/limit, and no size check is enforced (accept='.pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png' only). Remove button with aria-label and keyboard-focusable sr-only input are present, but the stated-limits requirement is not met generally.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: toast.success(`${firstName} ${lastName} was added as ${nextEmployeeId}.`) via sonner, which renders in an aria-live region. Not visually verified in screenshot.

notes: Audit score 80: radius-scale (4 radii incl. 14px cards, 10px inputs) and no-backdrop-blur (sticky bar uses bg-background/95 backdrop-blur). Font falls back to Times New Roman (no font loaded) which looks unfinished. Documents list is a bordered rounded bg-card list inside a Card (card-in-card). Confirmation checkbox is also a bordered card. Error clearing on change but no blur validation. Missing-document and confirm checks are in the summary, which is good.
